title: Agent runtime, AI gateway and inference substrate
subtitle: Three decoupled operational planes keep prompts, sessions and tool execution separate from provider routing and edge inference.
alt: Three-tier stack: an agent runtime handles sessions, context, tools and execution; an AI gateway control plane handles authentication, logging, rate limits, caching, retries and observability; and an inference substrate serves global model execution.
source: Derived from the OpenCode, Cloudflare AI Gateway and edge inference reference pattern.
